description.p: Aubade is a music player for your own collection. It scans your music folders, reads tags, and plays everything locally — no account, no streaming service, no uploads.

ul.li: Library of your local files, scanned incrementally and tagged with mutagen
Gapless playback with shuffle and repeat, powered by GStreamer
Cover art from embedded tags, folder images or subdirectories
Synchronised lyrics from embedded tags, .lrc sidecars and online sources
Media keys and GNOME control integration over MPRIS2
Plays statistics: top artists, albums and genres, recent plays

description.p: Flatpak packaging, desktop entry and AppStream metadata, so Aubade can be installed alongside the rest of the desktop.
